Noel: Christopher Bowen. Antonia: Sophie Ward. Richard: Sam Wanamaker. Danus: Mark Lewis Jones. Cosmo: Denis Quilley. Dolly: Irene Worth. Roy: Michael Gough. George: John Rowe. Filmed in England and Spain.

programme.title: Decoration Day
programme.desc: James Garner stars as a retired judge whose cantankerous attitude is tempered by a troubled godchild (Norm Skaggs), a black tenant farmer (Bill Cobbs) who refuses the Medal of Honor and a blossoming romance. Judith Ivey. Rowena: Ruby Dee. Michael Waring: Larry Fishburne. Loreen: Jo Anderson. Judge Wesley: Wallace Wilkinson. Adapted from the novella by John William Corrington.

programme.title: Horton Foote's 'Alone'
programme.desc: An elderly farmer (Hume Cronyn) who's contemplating retirement is pressured by his relatives to sell his property. Grey: James Earl Jones. Gus Jr.: Chris Cooper. Agnes: Hallie Foote. Jackie: Joanna Miles. Paul: David Selby. Estelle: Shelley Duvall. Carl: Frederic Forrest. Grace Ann: Roxanne Hart. Michael Lindsay-Hogg directed.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: Ladies of the House
programme.desc: Three women find solace in each other's company while rebuilding a home for their church's day-care program. The construction process proves therapeutic as they navigate their tumultuous personal lives.

programme.title: The Wishing Tree
programme.desc: An attorney (Alfre Woodard) returns to her native Georgia when her storyteller mother dies, and becomes involved in the case of a "magic man" accused of a crime. Thomas: Blair Underwood. Professor: Leslie Carlson. Wallis: Helen Shaver. Jamie: Stephen Joffe. Alexa: Kaleigh Nevin. Mattie: Mary Alice.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: In this drama based on the fourth book in Janette Oke's best-selling "Love Comes Softly" series, Missie and Willie LaHaye (Erin Cottrell, Logan Bartholomew) get accustomed to rugged frontier life, but tragedy threatens to shake up their stable family. Michael Landon Jr. directed.

programme.title: Honeymoon for One
programme.desc: A Los Angeles advertising exec travels to Ireland alone for her honeymoon after breaking things off with her dishonest fiancé. While abroad, she develops a connection with a local estate manager, but a conflict involving the woman's business threatens the budding romance.

programme.title: Chasing Leprechauns
programme.desc: Michael Garrett, a New York corporate troubleshooter, is sent to a small town in Ireland to close a deal on a construction site believed to be inhabited by leprechauns. Michael sets out to get the approval of the town's leprechaun expert, Sarah Cavanaugh, and soon finds that is easier said than done.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Wedding planner Abby specializes in fixing weddings that went wrong, but when she is forced to work with her ex-fiancé, she begins to question whether their relationship was the disaster she remembers.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the Civil War, America's South is looking to put the past behind it, and finds one path in a growing cultural passion of the North - football. In December 1932, the Southeastern Conference is officially formed.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Multiple SEC schools claim national titles from the 1930s through the '50s, including LSU with star running back Billy Cannon in 1958, prior to Cannon's epic game-winning punt return against powerhouse Ole Miss a year later.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: As a new decade dawns, quarterbacks Archie Manning, Bert Jones and Condredge Holloway build memorable legacies. Bear Bryant begins a new run of dominance at Alabama, and the rise of television sports transforms the SEC.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Nick Saban comes to LSU in 2000 and eventually wins the Tigers' first national championship since 1958 - a feat matched by Les Miles. At Florida, Tim Tebow becomes a cult hero and wins two national titles with Urban Meyer's Gators.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The SEC has a run of seven straight national titles, and nine in 12 years. Expansion in 2012 gives the conference 14 schools. Meanwhile, Nick Saban arguably becomes the greatest coach in the history of college football.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: Greek natives and their kin built the Birmingham restaurant scene, from barbecue joints to hotdog stands to steakhouses. Bright Star, founded in 1907, is the old guard and Johnny's is the new guard Greek restaurant.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: Pablo Rivadeneyra rotisserie-cooks lime-marinated chicken. Larry and Betty Jean Scott work a smoke-belching pit at Scott's BBQ. In these two places, we get a glimpse of the hard work that defines life in the South.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: Sands, the soul food café, cooks oxtails and cabbage and ropy okra; Arnold's Country Kitchen, Kahlil Arnold dishes created corn, hashed turnip greens, and fried green tomatoes; the differences between black and white cooking come into focus.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: Herby K's is a 1936 vintage beer garden and fry house. Lucky Palace serves wol-fried-t-bones and pork egg foo young. Both of these restaurants are survivors, like Shreveport itself.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: If you're a local of New Orleans, you might recognize West African borrowings in music and food but Italian New Orleans has been largely forgotten.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: This is a story about a scrappy onetime oil boomtown, where cooks make the most of scraps and the oppressiveness of brisket and how popular narratives have obscured two Gulf Coast dishes that manage to hang on.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: In the southern towns of Hodgenville and Bardstown, Kentucky, conflicting ideas about identity and purpose come into focus. In these Southern towns, onion burgers and country sausage prove constants in a time of great change.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: Just as there are many Souths, black Memphis reveals itself to be varied and complex and beautiful, Here, we see the streets of Memphis and its classic spots Pop's Hot Tamales, Lee Crumb, and Ms. Girlee's.

programme.desc: Recruited by MI6, British businessman Greville Wynne works with Soviet spy Oleg Penkovsky to obtain intelligence on the Cuban Missile Crisis.

programme.title: The Christine Jessop Story
programme.desc: On Dec. 31, 1984, 9-year-old Christine Jessop's decomposed body is discovered over 40 kilometers away; the search for the killer begins.

programme.title: Long Bright River
programme.desc: Mickey makes a big mistake in her hunt for the killer; her family helps to right the problem; a major showdown unites the neighborhood, but it turns deadly.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: No Refunds With Darcy and Jer
programme.desc: Married comedians Darcy and Jer bring their take on marriage, parenting, ADHD and mental health to the stage.

programme.title: I'm Still Here
programme.desc: As Brazil faces the tightening grip of a military dictatorship, Eunice Paiva, a mother of five, must reinvent herself and her family when authorities abduct her husband.

programme.title: Butterfly Tale
programme.desc: Two monarch butterflies become friends during their yearly migration south. Their journey, however, is not as simple as it seems as Patrick has only one wing and Jennifer is afraid of heights.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: An initially fun game of golf between Brent, Lacey and Hank quickly turns into a round robin of aggravation.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Karen and Davis investigate a mysterious crop circle near Dog River; Oscar and Emma repaint their house.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash helps Mags with a favor and navigates a challenge with Karim.

programme.title: I Am Alfred Hitchcock
programme.desc: Interviews and archival footage weave together to tell the story of the Master of Suspense, one of the most influential and studied filmmakers in the history of cinema.

programme.title: Snowmageddon
programme.desc: An Alaskan town faces destruction after a family finds on the doorstep a snow globe that affects the real world.

programme.title: Gunda
programme.desc: Filmmaker Victor Kossakovsky captures natural images of cows, chickens, and a pig and its litter.

programme.title: Ice Quake
programme.desc: Michael (Brendan Fehr), a military geologist, takes his family hiking in Alaska. After a series of earthquakes opens fissures and geysers in the ice, Michael realizes a greater catastrophe may be looming.

programme.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
programme.desc: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.

programme.title: Fanny: The Right to Rock
programme.desc: The story of a Filipina American garage band that morphed into the ferocious rock group Fanny, which almost became the female version of the Beatles.

programme.title: The Garfield Movie
programme.desc: Garfield, the Monday-hating, lasagna-loving indoor cat, finds himself on a wild outdoor adventure when his long-lost father draws him into a high-stakes heist.

programme.title: The Pod Generation
programme.desc: In the not-so-distant future, amid a society madly in love with technology, tech giant Pegazus offers couples the opportunity to share their pregnancies via detachable artificial wombs or pods. Rachel and Alvy's wild ride to parenthood begins.

programme.title: Desperation Road
programme.desc: A woman and her young daughter get caught in the crossfire when whiskey, guns and the desire for revenge violently intersect in a rough-and-tumble Mississippi town.

programme.title: Dead Man's Hand
programme.desc: A gunslinger teams up with a marshal to save his kidnapped wife from a ruthless mayor and his private army.

programme.title: The Lesson
programme.desc: Liam, an aspiring young writer, eagerly accepts a tutoring position at the family estate of his idol, renowned author J.M. Sinclair. However, Liam realizes he is ensnared in a web of family secrets and resentment.

programme.title: Millers in Marriage
programme.desc: Three middle-aged couples come to grips with universal questions about marriage and fidelity, professional success and failure and the challenge of finding a second act.

programme.title: One Ranger
programme.desc: Recruited by British intelligence, a Texas Ranger must track down and stop a dangerous terrorist from attacking London.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Wanda's latest crush gives her his number; Brent questions his sense of smell; the Ruby gets a touch up.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Emma and Karen look for a suitable gift to send their twin town in Japan; Wanda attempts to become the advice giving bartender.

programme.title: Fever Dream
programme.desc: A young woman lies in pain while a boy questions her about what happened. Together they unravel a haunting story of broken souls, toxins, looming environmental and spiritual catastrophes, and the ties that bind a parent to a child.

programme.title: Metal Tornado
programme.desc: A research team's experiments with solar energy accidentally create massive magnetic vortexes that destroy everything in their path.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Dolphin Bay
programme.desc: A group of friends are spending the summer working as interns at a research center, which is researching unnatural changes in the local reef. After strange events begin to occur, the friends suspect a local legend may be tied to the reef's problems.

programme.title: Butterfly Tale
programme.desc: Two monarch butterflies become friends during their yearly migration south. Their journey, however, is not as simple as it seems as Patrick has only one wing and Jennifer is afraid of heights.

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: A single mother demands answers from a school teacher when her son begins acting strangely. A fight at school causes even more trouble.

programme.title: Camp Cold Brook
programme.desc: Strange events plague crew members of a reality TV show when they visit an infamous backwoods camp that was the site of a mass murder 20 years earlier.

programme.title: Dark Side of the 90s
programme.desc: In the '90s, the surge of internet-exclusive companies captures the dreams and greed of American investors; in its wake, the beloved Pets.com puppet is killed.

programme.title: Selena + Chef
programme.desc: Pastry chef and activist Paola Velez comes ready with a sweet treat for Selena, helping her create a chocolate cookie icebox cake; also on the menu are beef empanadas.Guests: Paola Velez..

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realizes that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

programme.title: Till
programme.desc: The true story of Mamie Till-Mobley's relentless pursuit of justice for her 14-year-old son, Emmett Till, who was brutally lynched in 1955 while visiting his cousins in Mississippi.

programme.title: Redeeming Love
programme.desc: After meeting Michael and experiencing love for the first time, Angel, facing demons that seem unbeatable, learns that she has the power to choose the life she wants.

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he must prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.
